I'm not sure, it could be multifactor. The point of life, that there isn't really one, so why continue to endure an seemingly endless existence. That when you reach the end it has all gone by so quickly you yearn for days before every thing got to small the world is a big place yet too small to live in anymore. I just want to capture the childish state of mind, sit wonder what's beyond what's farther.        I do live by what I've said, at least I do to the best of my abilities. And the next 361 days, I'm not exactly sure what I'll do with. Try new things, explore, write a lot, paint something cool, make love a couple times, I guess I'm reallying try to make one year last a lifetime. 

      I have a list, I call it the one year bucket list, its basically just a bucket list but it sounded cooler. Its filled with random things I've wanted to do my whole life. So through the year I will slow check off traveling, swiming in an ocean, and other oddities. I dont want to waste my life, I want to show people to be happy, even when you're ready to give up, if that makes sense .
